newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ONFEM to sell 40 pct of Oriental Metals.
newsitem.headline: ONFEM to sell 40 pct of Oriental Metals.

text.p: ONFEM Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to sell a 40 percent stake in Oriental Metals (Holdings) Co Ltd to ONFEM parent China Nonferrous Metals Holdings (Hong Kong) Ltd for HK$354.5 million.

ONFEM said in a statement that China Nonferrous Metals, owned by state-owned China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corp, would pay HK$1.60 a share for 221.56 million Oriental Metals shares, representing a two percent discount from Monday's closing price of HK$1.64.
Trading in Oriental Metals was suspended on Tuesday morning. Application was made to resume trading on Thursday, ONFEM said.
After the reorganisation, ONFEM would dilute its stake in Oriental Metals to 10.8 percent and China Nonferrous Metals would have a direct stake in Oriental Metals, it said.
